source_versions: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg12+2), Linux arm64, local Compose source profile
authentication_methods: Password resolved from a tenant-bound site-local credential reference; generic targets require operator-approved verify-full TLS with a private CA policy
required_permissions: SELECT all relations in scan scope
tenant_scope: Credential and operator target policy independently bind tenant IDs and exact host, port, database and schema
network_destinations: Exact operator-approved PostgreSQL host and port, with every resolved address admitted by explicit CIDRs and pinned for verify-full TLS
Bundled synthetic profile only: source-postgres:5432 / harbor / public; explicit separate local plaintext exception
source_identity_rules: Within an existing registered source/database: database OID + relation OID + column attnum; display paths never identify objects. Database recreation/recycled-OID detection and source epochs remain unimplemented.
pagination: bounded full catalog snapshot, 10000 records / 8 MiB; exceeding bound fails without completion
incremental_cursor_behavior: not implemented; repeatable-read scope-complete snapshots only
retry_classes: site transport transient errors retried through Temporal; source error terminates scan with sanitized code
deletion_strategy: only successful complete manifests qualify; permission fingerprint changes prohibit absence-based deletion

limitations: Bounded schema/table/view/column catalog extraction; bundled local metadata qualification is distinct from the configurable target policy/TLS native gate.
Configurable targets are implemented with DNS/CIDR pinning and verify-full TLS. Other source versions, architectures, external deployments and end-to-end custom-target scans remain unqualified.
Database/cluster recreation and recycled OID detection are not implemented; source-epoch reconciliation remains required and unverified.
Bounded native pg_rewrite/pg_depend table/view dependencies within one successful registered-source scan.
Routine bodies, out-of-scope relations and unsupported relation kinds are explicit gaps. No SQL bodies, output-column mappings or cross-system stitching are inferred.
Local synthetic Linux arm64 source only; other versions and external deployments remain unqualified.
